EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 364 January 11, 1972
CREATING THE PHILIPPINE COMMITTEE FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE ASIAN
HANDICRAFT CENTER
WHEREAS, the Philippines has been chosen as the Asian Handicraft Center during the recently-concluded
ECAFE Second Preparatory Meeting for the Establishment of said Center; and
WHEREAS, there is need for the immediate establishment of the Center, programmed to be inaugurated in
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by law, do hereby create the Philippine Committee for the Establishment of the Asian Handicraft
Center composed of the following:
Mr. Mario R. Reyes
(Administrator, NACIDA)
Acting Undersecretary of Industry
Mr. Hilarion A. Pilapil
Action Officer
Deputy Administrator NACIDA
Mr. Leon V. Chico
Director, Institute for Small Scale Industries
University of the Philippines
Mr. Benjamin G. Villavicencio
Director, Office of Foreign Aid Coordination
National Economic Council
The Committee is charged with the following duties and responsibilities;
a) Determine the site, location, building and other requirements for the establishment of the Asian Handicraft
Center in the Philippines;
b) Implement various matters taken up during the Second Preparatory Meeting for the Establishment of the
Asian Handicraft Center held at Bangkok, Thailand on November 8 to 12, 1971;
c) Comply with the necessary requirements for the participation of the Philippines in the national pavilion
project of the Center for the display and sale of handicraft products;
d) Screen and nominate proper Philippine officials and staff members for the management and operation of
the Asian Handicraft Center;
e) Serve as the liaison body of the Philippines with ECAFE, the Governing Council of the Center and other
international agencies involved in the project; and
f) Submit to the proper authorities a progress report of its accomplishments from time to time, as may be
The Chairman is hereby authorized to call upon any officer or employee of any department, bureau, office,
agency or instrumentality of the Government, including corporations owned and controlled by it for such
assistance as may be needed by the Committee for the proper discharge of its functions and duties. Their
expenses and those of the Committee shall be borne by their respective agencies, subject to availability of
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-two.
